tasks.instruction_text: I want to browse Netflix titles longer than two hours. Use the Runtime filter and pick the 'Over 120 min' bucket.
Filter Netflix's catalog to the '30-60 min' Runtime bucket — typical episode length for prestige drama.
Set the Runtime filter to the '60-90 min' bucket — short documentaries and movies. Don't pick the '30-60 min' or '90-120 min' tier.
Apply the 'Under 30 min' Runtime bucket so I see only short animated series and shorts.
Apply the 'Over 120 min' Runtime bucket. From the visible titles in that bucket, how many are there?
Filter to the '30-60 min' Runtime bucket. Which title in that bucket is from 2022 — give the title and its runtime in minutes.
Set Runtime to '60-90 min'. Within that bucket, which title is a 2020 documentary about an octopus? Give the title and runtime.
